children: Lipocine announced initiation of the BLOOM Phase 3 study of LPCN 1154 for postpartum depression, with first dosing expected in early Q4 2026.
Initiated BLOOM Phase 3 outpatient, placebo-controlled study of LPCN 1154 aiming to support a 505(b)(2) NDA.
Study to enroll ~120 participants with severe PPD; first participant dosing expected in early Q4 2026.
Design uses same 48-hour at-home dosing and HAM-D17 primary endpoint assessed at 60 hours post-dose.
Enhanced site and data-quality controls and prespecified sensitivity analyses to address prior trial anomalies.
Company expects existing resources to support BLOOM with ~ $1 million average cash use per month; $23.3M cash as of June 30, 2026.

title: Lipocine launches BLOOM Phase 3 study of LPCN 1154 for PPD; plans ~120 patients, expects $1M/mo cash use
